about.bio:
I'm Aarav, a self-taught developer from Delhi, India. I fell in love with code because it lets me turn the wild ideas in my head into real things people can click, play and use.

I design and build websites, web apps, Discord bots and small games — with a big focus on speed, clean design and the tiny details most people never notice. I don't talk much about what I'm building. I just ship it.
